# Krzysztof Czarnecki

Krzysztof Czarnecki (Blackecki) is based in Pruszcz Gdański, Poland, and is looking for Junior IT Support, Service Desk L1 or helpdesk work. English C1; Polish native.

## Background

- IQFM, Retail Merchandiser, July–August 2026: in-store customer service, stock display and work reports.
- H2B, Gdańsk, IT Intern, March–April 2024 and March–April 2025: printer, document and file support, Python shortest-path algorithms and assigned team tasks.
- Pomorskie Szkoły Rzemiosł, programming profile, 2021–2026. Matura and INF.03 qualification.
- Tools of the Trade: Linux and SQL, Google, July 2026.
- Google Cybersecurity Professional Certificate: final stage, in progress.
- Driving licence: category B.

## Skills and projects

Windows, Linux (Ubuntu), Qubes OS, VMware, SSH, Raspberry Pi, TCP/IP, DNS, DHCP, HTTP/HTTPS, LAN, Python, Bash and Git. Basic SQL and C#. Course exercises with Wireshark, tcpdump and VirusTotal.

- [Home lab](https://blackecki.github.io/portfolio/projects/home-lab.html): Linux server with SSH and a website, Pi-hole on Raspberry Pi 4 Model B, Windows/Linux VMs and coreboot on a ThinkPad T440p using Raspberry Pi and Skulls instructions.
- [Minecraft backups](https://blackecki.github.io/portfolio/projects/home-lab.html#backups): Bash script creating tar.gz archives, excluding directories and checking the command result. The script and a restore-test log are not published.
- [Cryplab](https://blackecki.github.io/portfolio/projects/cryplab.html): Python CLI for SHA-256 text/file hashing, AES-256-GCM encryption and key export. [Nine function checks passed](https://blackecki.github.io/portfolio/assets/cryplab-verification.txt) at commit b56f464. [Source](https://github.com/Blackecki/Cryplab).
- [Retro Forum](https://blackecki.github.io/portfolio/projects/retro-forum.html): Next.js, TypeScript, Prisma and SQLite, with JWT sessions, bcrypt and login limits. Built with AI assistance; Krzysztof reviewed authentication, authorization and session code. [Source](https://github.com/Blackecki/retro-forum). No published runtime test report or public demo.
- [Course case notes](https://blackecki.github.io/portfolio/#case-notes): phishing triage, DNS errors and a SYN flood scenario. Proposed checks are distinguished from work completed.
- [Incident handler's journal](https://blackecki.github.io/portfolio/projects/incident-handler-journal.html): four entries dated 11 November 2026 covering ransomware, Wireshark, tcpdump and VirusTotal. Original reports and worksheets are on the [materials page](https://blackecki.github.io/portfolio/materials.html).
